review_candidates.description: Join ANH-Solutions’ global Digital & Technology team to lead SAP Product Life-ciclye Management and EH&S capabilities that enable product development, compliance and sustainable animal nutrition. Shape a value-driven digital roadmap, connect business and technology, and deliver scalable innovation across the product lifecycle in a customer-focused company operating in 55 countries. ANH-Solutions is a customer-focused, innovation-driven solutions company dedicated entirely to animal nutrition and operating globally across 55 countries. It combines products, services, data and expertise to help customers improve performance, manage complexity and make more sustainable choices through practical, science-based solutions. Key Responsibilities Partner with R&D, Product Development, Regulatory Affairs, Product Stewardship, Quality, EH&S and Supply Chain teams to translate business requirements into scalable SAP solutions. Lead the functional design, implementation and continuous evolution of SAP PLM and SAP EH&S capabilities across product development, product compliance and regulatory processes. Architect end-to-end integrations between SAP PLM/EH&S and SAP ECC, master data solutions, LIMS, Quality Management, Manufacturing, Procurement and external regulatory platforms. Govern product master data, specifications, formulations, substance data and compliance information to ensure integrity and meet global regulatory and sustainability requirements. Drive the value-based digital roadmap, process automation, continuous improvement and successful adoption of PLM and EH&S solutions throughout the product lifecycle. Manage global stakeholders, architects, developers and service partners while aligning priorities and mitigating delivery, integration, compliance and data-quality risks. We Offer A promising future as we are the number one provider of advanced feed additives, and premixes, supercharged by AI-driven precision services An eagerness to go above and beyond customer needs, driven by a vital purpose: making animal farming more sustainable A collaborative culture where your ideas and voice matter. A flexible work environment that empowers people to take accountability for their work and own the outcome Recognition and celebration of your efforts and accomplishments Opportunities for growth and advancement for those who embrace innovation and take initiative You Bring Hands-on experience with SAP PLM and SAP EH&S/Product Compliance, including Recipe Development, Specification Management, Product Stewardship, Regulatory Compliance, and Sustainability processes within process industries. Proven expertise in designing, configuring, and optimizing SAP PLM and EH&S solutions, covering recipe and formula management, specifications, product composition, product safety, dangerous goods, SDS management, global label management, and regulatory compliance reporting. Strong technical knowledge of WWI layout design, Global Label Management (GLM), and integration of SAP PLM/EH&S with SAP ECC and regulatory information management systems, QM, Manufacturing, Procurement, LIMS, regulatory platforms, and other enterprise applications. Deep understanding of product lifecycle management, formulation processes, product master data, compliance requirements, labeling regulations, and global product registration, ensuring data integrity and regulatory adherence. Demonstrated ability to lead end-to-end solution delivery in complex global environments, translating business requirements into scalable solutions and driving implementation, testing, deployment, adoption, and continuous improvement. Strong business partnership, stakeholder management, and communication skills, complemented by knowledge of SAP Fiori, SAP BTP, ABAP, ADS, application lifecycle management, and digital operations. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant discipline and fluent English required. Our shared missionto serve patients living with serious illnessesdrives all that we do. Since 1980, weve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the worlds toughest diseases. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline and portfolio of medicines to treat heart disease, obesity and obesity-related conditions, rare diseases, inflammatory conditions and cancer. As a member of the Amgen team, youll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives. Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, youll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career. Global Meetings & Events Manager, Meeting Planning What you will do Lets do this. Lets change the world. Reporting to the Associate Director, Meeting Planning, on the Global Meetings Management team (GMM), the Manager is the primary planning partner for sponsors and accountable for program strategy, attendee experience, budget, compliance, and execution. Translate business objectives into actionable plans, timelines, agendas, and operational workstreams. Manage multiple programs simultaneously, including priorities, risks, contingencies, and stakeholder expectations. Partner with sponsors, senior leaders, and key stakeholders to define objectives and measure success. Lead planning meetings, communicate progress, and proactively resolve issues and risks. Oversee the end-to-end attendee experience, including registration, communications, travel, accommodations, and onsite support. Direct onsite event operations, ensuring seamless execution and issue resolution. Manage program budgets, forecasts, financial tracking, and reporting. Ensure compliance with company policies, legal requirements, and audit standards. Identify and mitigate operational, financial, safety, and reputational risks. OR Bachelors degree and 4 years of corporate event management, ideally within life sciences or highly regulated industries experience. OR Associates degree and 8 years of corporate event management, ideally within life sciences or highly regulated industries experience. OR High school diploma / GED and 10 years of corporate event management, ideally within life sciences or highly regulated industries experience. Preferred Qualifications Experience in life sciences or another regulated industry; familiarity with virtual and hybrid meeting platforms and attendee-facing event apps. Bachelors degree in hospitality, business, communications, event management, or a related field; equivalent experience considered. 5+ years of corporate or agency meeting or event planning experience delivering complex, high-visibility programs in a corporate environment. Experience managing budgets, forecasts, supplier scopes, invoice review, payment coordination, and post-event reconciliation. Proficiency in Cvent and Microsoft Office, with experience using registration and project management tools. Strong cross-functional collaboration, stakeholder management, communication, organization, judgment, discretion, and problem-solving skills; experience providing day-to-day direction, coaching, or oversight to planning colleagues. Able to manage competing priorities and lead onsite execution in a fast-paced environment. Approximately 30% travel for onsite event support, with occasional evening or weekend work based on program schedules What you can expect from us As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. Internationale personelle Zusammenarbeit gestalten. Globale Partnerschaften stärken. Zukunft verantworten. AGIAMONDO e. V. ist der katholische Personaldienst für internationale personelle Zusammenarbeit. Seit über 60 Jahren fördern wir den Austausch von Kompetenzen, Erfahrungen und Perspektiven über Ländergrenzen hinweg. Durch die Vermittlung qualifizierter Fach- und Führungskräfte, die Begleitung internationaler Freiwilligendienste sowie die Umsetzung des Zivilen Friedensdienstes leisten wir Beiträge zu Frieden, Gerechtigkeit und nachhaltiger Entwicklung. Unsere besondere Stärke liegt in der Überzeugung, dass gesellschaftlicher Wandel durch Menschen entsteht, die Wissen, Erfahrung und Engagement über Grenzen hinweg einbringen. Als Brückenbauer zwischen Partnerorganisationen weltweit, Fachkräften, Freiwilligen, kirchlichen Einrichtungen und öffentlichen Institutionen gestalten wir internationale personelle Zusammenarbeit wirksam und zukunftsorientiert. Ein besonderer Schwerpunkt der strategischen Weiterentwicklung von AGIAMONDO liegt derzeit im Aufbau des Geschäftsfeldes Faire Arbeitsmigration. Hier vermitteln wir qualifizierte Pflegefachkräfte und Auszubildende aus dem Globalen Süden an Gesundheitseinrichtungen in Deutschland, verantwortungsvoll, partnerschaftlich und nachhaltig. Gestalten Sie die Zukunft internationaler personeller Zusammenarbeit. Für die strategische, personelle und wirtschaftliche Gesamtverantwortung von AGIAMONDO suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine überzeugende Führungspersönlichkeit mit internationaler Erfahrung, klarem Wertekompass und ausgeprägter Gestaltungskraft. Sie tragen gemeinsam die Gesamtverantwortung für die strategische, operative und wirtschaftliche Führung von AGIAMONDO. Sie vertreten den Verein nach außen, leiten die Geschäftsstelle mit rund 60 Mitarbeitenden und führen die Organisation im Einklang mit den Beschlüssen der Mitgliederversammlung sowie den Leitlinien des Aufsichtsrats. Strategische Weiterentwicklung: Sie gestalten die zukunftsfähige Ausrichtung der internationalen personellen Zusammenarbeit und entwickeln AGIAMONDO vor dem Hintergrund globaler Transformationsprozesse, des sozial-ökologischen Wandels und sich verändernder geopolitischer Rahmenbedingungen weiter. Führung und Organisationsentwicklung: Sie führen die Mitarbeitenden der Geschäftsstelle wertschätzend, partizipativ und zielorientiert. Dabei fördern Sie die Weiterentwicklung von AGIAMONDO zu einer modernen, lernenden und zukunftsfähigen Organisation. Ihr Profil: Sie verfügen über ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes einschlägiges Hochschulstudium. Sie bringen langjährige Berufserfahrung in der internationalen personellen Zusammenarbeit mit, idealerweise mit eigener Tätigkeit als Fachkraft in der Entwicklungszusammenarbeit oder Friedensförderung. Sie verfügen über fundierte theoretische und praktische Kenntnisse aktueller friedenspolitischer Debatten sowie der relevanten Ansätze ziviler Friedensarbeit und Konflikttransformation. Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Berufs- und Führungserfahrung in einer NGO, einem Verband, einer kirchlichen Organisation oder einer vergleichbaren Institution. Sie verfügen über fundierte Kenntnisse im Non-Profit-Management, im Vereins- und Arbeitsrecht sowie im Umgang mit öffentlichen und kirchlichen Fördermitteln. Sie kommunizieren verhandlungssicher in mindestens zwei internationalen Verkehrssprachen. Sie identifizieren sich mit den Zielen und Werten der katholischen Kirche sowie der christlichen Soziallehre und verfügen über ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für interkulturelle Zusammenarbeit und globale Zusammenhänge. Sie überzeugen durch strategisches und analytisches Denkvermögen, Verhandlungsgeschick, diplomatische Kommunikationsstärke sowie ein souveränes Auftreten im kirchlichen, politischen und internationalen Umfeld. Unser Angebot : Die Möglichkeit, die Zukunft der internationalen personellen Zusammenarbeit in einer etablierten und werteorientierten Organisation aktiv mitzugestalten. Eine Führungsaufgabe mit hohem strategischem Gestaltungsspielraum und internationaler Wirkung. Die Zusammenarbeit mit einem engagierten Team sowie einem starken Netzwerk kirchlicher, zivilgesellschaftlicher und internationaler Partner. Eine der Verantwortung der Position angemessene Vergütung in Anlehnung an den TVöD einschließlich betrieblicher Altersversorgung und attraktiver Sozialleistungen. Ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld in unserer Geschäftsstelle in Köln und flexible Möglichkeiten für mobiles Arbeiten. AGIAMONDO bemüht sich um Vereinbarkeit von Familie und Beruf. Ltd. is a professional services organization focused on delivering reliable human resources and business support solutions to a diverse range of clients. The company emphasizes operational efficiency, accurate reporting, and strong financial oversight to support sustainable business growth. Team members collaborate across departments to improve internal processes and provide data-driven insights to clients and stakeholders. HR Service Co. Ltd. offers opportunities for professional development and values integrity, accountability, and service excellence in all areas of its operations. Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Financial Analyst role based in Yangon. The Financial Analyst will prepare, analyze, and interpret financial reports to support decision-making and monitor company performance. Day-to-day responsibilities include reviewing financial statements, conducting variance and trend analyses, supporting budgeting and forecasting processes, and preparing presentations for management. The role also involves collaborating with accounting and operations teams, ensuring data accuracy, and identifying opportunities to improve financial efficiency and control. The Financial Analyst is expected to maintain clear documentation and provide timely, well-supported recommendations to leadership. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Finance knowledge and experience working with core financial concepts. Candidates should possess skills in Financial Planning, including budgeting, forecasting, and scenario analysis. Candidates should possess the ability to analyze Financial Statements and interpret key performance indicators. Candidates should possess experience in Financial Reporting, ensuring accuracy, clarity, and compliance with internal standards. Candidates should possess advanced Analytical Skills, including proficiency with spreadsheets and financial modeling tools. Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field. Strong attention to detail, numerical accuracy, and ability to meet deadlines. Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex information clearly. Wij vragen Wij zoeken een ervaren en verbindende professional die strategisch kan denken én weet hoe je plannen in de praktijk realiseert. Daarbij worden vaak ook woorden genoemd als saamhorig en laagdrempelig.
